scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Present-day explicit_attestation is truthful; original historical bytes and assurance remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a complete old-v1 source with historical producer distinct from present registrar; reject hash-only/incomplete sources.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 完整来源登记、不同历史 producer 与当前 registrar、拒绝 self-source/错误 repository identity；不重新认证历史验证。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Only exact original binding/bytes resume; pending does not permanently block its own recovery; conflicting or corrupt records remain preserved and rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt before/after requirement and registration publication; plan and record requirement-only and registration-only cases.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 首次准确 bytes/binding 的双方缺一恢复与 abrupt-exit 矩阵已通过；伪造首次 resume 和损坏 survivor 被拒绝。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Single immutable winner, no lost update, stale/conflict on drift, no overwrite.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Race same/different WI and binding; change source/destination/inventory/head/admission after plan.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 同 binding 并发权威结果和冲突 plan 保留；相同内容替换根/Git/来源以及来源 HEAD 漂移被拒绝。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No escaped read/write or victim replacement; invalid inputs fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise bounded reads, duplicate keys/paths, symlink/reparse, directory replacement, traversal and hardlink victims.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Linux 实测覆盖 bounded input、重复 JSON key、路径别名、父目录替换、symlink/hardlink/directory victim 和 FIFO；Windows reparse 执行证据缺失。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Closed revoked, explicit blocker, WI retained in readiness, overlapping scope rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Remove/change each required record/dependency; remove archive directory or Contract+manifest; set closeRequired=false or foreign repository.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 逐类原始证明/根记录/委托依赖丢失撤销 closed，archive 丢失仍枚举，foreign scope 不能逃逸，overlap preflight 保持阻断。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: One authoritative write sequence; typed held-lock/internal contract prevents recursive acquisition and unlocked exposure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Call normal finalization and explicit extension path with held/unheld lock contexts and concurrent writers.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 标准 finalization 和 extension 使用同一 writer；三个真实锁回归验证同 WI 等待、跨 WI 独立、错误 guard 拒绝。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Read back original exact transition and return original result; no regenerated actor/time/Runtime bytes and no false next-sequence conflict.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Publish exact transition, fail reporting, then retry with original durable template/version before evaluating next-sequence.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 已提交原 transition 先于 next-sequence 判断被读回重放；canonical 等价但 raw 改动被拒绝，发布后报告 I/O 失败保留 committed/unknown 事实。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Exact constrained resume works without prior registered_valid/closed; unbound decisions, invalid forks and missing proofs remain blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt extension/transition publication; test lawful Retained→Deleted, already-present Deleted, forks, extra decisions and wrong identity.
scenarioCoverage.reason: root/extension pending 仅原绑定准确 bytes 恢复；合法已有 Deleted 纳入根，错序/fork/身份/资源仍在保持拒绝。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Existing compatibility and historical not_ready are retained; plan is read-only and both surfaces share semantics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Read ordinary closes, v2 and unregistered v1 through repository/CLI/MCP, and test new plan/record input parity.
scenarioCoverage.reason: ordinary/v1 读兼容、v2 identity、CLI/MCP 严格入口与实际 transport/replay/resume/offline/proof-loss 行为通过；无自动迁移。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No fabricated historical authentication or remote immutable-anchor guarantee.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Document supported surviving-proof detection and complete local provenance-loss/rollback limits.
scenarioCoverage.reason: 三语明确 current explicit_attestation、非历史重新认证、原来源可离线和全部本地锚点消失/回滚不可识别；不宣称远端单调保证。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No recursive lock or unguarded writer, bounded failure for cyclic dependencies, no default permanent source-checkout dependency, damaged canonical records retain scope obligation and all required validity predicates remain conjunctive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise crate-private matching lock-guard callers, cross-WI cycles/depth, offline original source after complete registration, malformed/foreign canonical registration names and old-v1/provider failures with apparently valid registration.
scenarioCoverage.reason: typed matching guard、循环/深度/重复工作预算、离线原来源、canonical 损坏/foreign 名称枚举与旧验证/provider/登记合取保持 fail closed。
